name: Annapolis (United States)

colors.symbolism: the crown and the motto ribbon
the Tudor rose and details of the crown
the stems and leaves of the sprig

description: A white field bearing a royal crown above a sprig with a thistle and a Tudor rose, over a gold ribbon inscribed 'VIXI LIBER ET MORIAR' ('I have lived free and shall die free').
history: The current flag was adopted in 2020, replacing an earlier design and emphasising Annapolis's role as the capital of Maryland and its colonial and early-republic heritage.

features.role: thistle and Tudor rose on a green sprig
